description: This file defines the SkillsSettings SwiftUI view for managing and displaying skills, their statuses, and configurations within the OpenClaw application. It includes view structures, view models, and auxiliary components related to skill management.

classes.name: SkillsSettingsModel
classes.description: An observable class managing the state and operations related to skills, including fetching status, enabling/disabling skills, installing, and updating environment variables.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Fetches the latest skills status report asynchronously and updates the skills array.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Installs a specified skill with a given option on a target (local or gateway) asynchronously.

methods.name: setEnabled
methods.description: Enables or disables a skill asynchronously.

methods.name: updateEnv
methods.description: Updates environment variables or API keys for a skill asynchronously.

methods.name: isBusy
methods.description: Checks if a particular skill is currently busy.

methods.name: withBusy
methods.description: Internal helper to mark a skill as busy during an asynchronous operation.
